sources.title: Lei nº 21/VI/2003 de 14 de Julho — Regulamento do Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado (IVA)
sources.institution: Ministério das Finanças / Direção Nacional das Receitas de Estado
sources.coverage: IVA standard rate (Art. 17); export/international transport exemptions with right to deduction (Art. 13)
sources.notes: Approved by the National Assembly 24 April 2003, promulgated 3 July 2003, in force since 1 January 2004. Downloaded directly from the official Ministério das Finanças portal (mf.gov.cv), text-based PDF (59 pages, not scanned).

sources.title: Lei nº 22/VI/2003 de 14 de Julho — Regulamento do Imposto sobre Consumos Especiais (ICE)
sources.institution: Instituto de Gestão da Administração Estatal (IGAE) / Ministério das Finanças
sources.coverage: ICE import tax base (Art. 13: IVA import value plus all duties and taxes except ICE itself)
sources.notes: Cape Verde's excise-equivalent instrument (ICE), enacted the same day as the IVA law (Lei 21/VI/2003). Text versed to the repository as data/cpv/reference/CPV_ICE.pdf (same SHA-256); ICE rates per position come from the Pauta Aduaneira (fiche CPV_pauta_IVA_ICE_2026-10-12.json).
